entries.claim: If A(x1,y1), B(x2,y2), M(x,y) where M is the midpoint of AB, then triangles BEM and MDA are congruent, so AD = ME. Hence x − x1 = x2 − x, so 2x = x1 + x2, x = (x1+x2)/2. Similarly MD = BE gives y − y1 = y2 − y, so 2y = y1 + y2, y = (y1+y2)/2. So M((x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2).
entries.quote: If A (x1, y1), B (x2, y2), M (x, y) where M in the midpoint
entries.note: The page contains all stated elements: congruent triangles BEM and MDA, equal segments AD=ME and MD=BE, algebraic steps deriving x=(x₁+x₂)/2 and y=(y₁+y₂)/2, and the final midpoint formula.
